compatibility_checks.title: Target agitation speed (S-TIP)

compatibility_checks.title: Target ungassed power draw vs motor limit (S-TIP)

compatibility_checks.title: Target instrumentation and control capabilities
compatibility_checks.explanation: Target vessel documents all required sensors/controls (do_probe, temperature_probe).

risk_flags.title: Required engineering inputs missing for scale-up calculation
risk_flags.explanation: 10 calculation(s) (F-OTR-001, F-OTR-MAX, F-PV-001, F-PWR-001, F-RE-001, F-TIP-001) could not be evaluated due to missing inputs: N (agitation_speed), P (power_draw or F-PWR-001), kLa (volumetric mass-transfer coefficient).
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Provide measured or documented values for: N (agitation_speed), P (power_draw or F-PWR-001), kLa (volumetric mass-transfer coefficient)

risk_flags.title: Scale-up calculation relies on user-assumed properties
risk_flags.explanation: Calculations (F-DOC-001, F-OTR-001, F-OTR-MAX, F-PWR-001, F-RE-001) rely on one or more user-assumed physical properties rather than direct measurements.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Replace user-assumed medium/process properties (e.g. density, viscosity, C*) with laboratory measurements.

risk_flags.title: Source batch data-quality issues affect engineering inputs
risk_flags.explanation: No high-severity data-quality issues reported on source batch operating variables.

risk_flags.title: DO or pH sensor calibration status undocumented
risk_flags.explanation: Primary sensor calibration status is documented as calibrated pre-run.

risk_flags.title: Assessment uses synthetic or demonstration dataset
risk_flags.explanation: This assessment uses data marked as synthetic/demonstration. Outputs illustrate workflow mechanics and must not be used for physical pilot execution.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Import a verified laboratory fermentation dataset from the actual organism and bench bioreactor.

risk_flags.title: Assessment includes formulas pending domain-expert sign-off
risk_flags.explanation: Computed results include formula(s) with status 'pending_review': F-DOC-001, F-PWR-001, F-VS-001.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Complete independent bioprocess advisor review of proposed engineering correlations.

risk_flags.title: Source batch dissolved oxygen fell below required threshold
risk_flags.explanation: Source batch minimum DO reached 18.0 % air sat, falling below required minimum DO (20.0 % air sat). The lab process may already experience oxygen limitation.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Investigate whether transient DO dips at bench scale impacted yield and confirm critical DO threshold.

risk_flags.title: No kLa evidence documented for target vessel
risk_flags.explanation: Target vessel profile has no documented kLa evidence point. Target oxygen transfer rate (OTR) cannot be evaluated.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Measured kLa in target vessel across planned agitation and aeration operating envelope.

risk_flags.title: Target OTR capacity vs peak process oxygen demand (OUR)
risk_flags.explanation: Cannot compare target oxygen transfer capacity against process oxygen demand: missing target OTR (requires target kLa, C*, and required DO).
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Quantify target OTR (requires target kLa, C*, and required DO) to verify oxygen transfer adequacy before pilot scale-up.

risk_flags.title: Scale-up criterion trade-off violates process constraint or ratio band
risk_flags.explanation: Criterion S-PV yields u_tip = 2.21 m/s > constraint 2.00 m/s.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Bioprocess engineer review of conflicting scale-up criteria (constant P/V vs tip speed vs aeration).

risk_flags.title: Mixing-time characterization missing for target vessel
risk_flags.explanation: No measured mixing-time evidence is documented for the target vessel. Larger scale typically increases circulation and mixing times, which can cause substrate or pH gradients during fed-batch operation.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Target vessel mixing time (t_95) measurement or facility characterization report.

risk_flags.title: Impeller Reynolds number vs turbulent regime threshold
risk_flags.explanation: Minimum computed Reynolds number is 25,208, but 're_turbulent_min' threshold is not configured.

risk_flags.title: Geometric or impeller dissimilarity between source and target vessels
risk_flags.explanation: Geometric similarity ratios were computed, but no 'geometric_similarity_tolerance' is configured.

risk_flags.title: Target vessel cooling capacity undocumented
risk_flags.explanation: Target vessel cooling capacity is not documented. Heat removal often becomes limiting at larger scale due to lower surface-area-to-volume ratio.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Obtain target jacket/coil cooling capacity (in W or kW at process temperature) from facility or vendor.

risk_flags.title: Estimated process heat load vs target vessel cooling capacity
risk_flags.explanation: Cannot evaluate thermal balance because estimated heat load or target cooling capacity is not provided.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Provide estimated peak metabolic + mechanical heat load and target cooling capacity.

risk_flags.title: Source batch temperature deviation from setpoint
risk_flags.explanation: Cannot evaluate source batch temperature deviation because measured temperature or temperature setpoint is unavailable.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Provide source batch temperature time series and the process temperature setpoint.

risk_flags.title: Target vessel capability envelope incomplete for compatibility check
risk_flags.explanation: Equipment compatibility check(s) (C-AGIT-RANGE, C-COOLING, C-MOTOR-POWER, C-TEMP-RANGE) could not be evaluated due to missing vessel capability limits or missing operating point inputs.
risk_flags.evidence_gap: Complete target vessel capability envelope (min/max agitation, motor power, gas flow, cooling, instrumentation).

validation_tasks.title: Request target vessel cooling capacity specification from facility/vendor
validation_tasks.description: Obtain maximum jacket/coil heat removal rate (kW) at the target fermentation temperature and utility chilled-water supply temperature.

validation_tasks.title: Replace synthetic/demo dataset with real laboratory fermentation batch data
validation_tasks.description: Import verified experimental batch exports from the laboratory bioreactor before making pilot transfer decisions.

validation_tasks.title: Measure or obtain verified kLa in target vessel across planned (N, Q_g) range
validation_tasks.description: Conduct dynamic gassing-out or sulfite kLa characterization in the target vessel (or obtain verified facility test data) covering the target agitation and aeration operating point.

validation_tasks.title: Quantify peak oxygen uptake rate (OUR) in laboratory process
validation_tasks.description: Measure peak OUR via exhaust gas O₂/CO₂ analysis or dynamic DO depletion during peak metabolic phase.

validation_tasks.title: Bioprocess engineer review of scale-up criterion selection and descriptor trade-offs
validation_tasks.description: Evaluate trade-offs between preserving constant P/V, tip speed, and vvm/v_s for the organism's shear and oxygen sensitivity.

validation_tasks.title: Bioprocess engineer review of oxygen transfer balance and gas supply strategy
validation_tasks.description: Review OTR = kLa(C* - C_L) driving force, headpressure effects, and O₂ enrichment options with a senior bioprocess engineer.

validation_tasks.title: Perform metabolic + agitation heat balance against target cooling capability
validation_tasks.description: Calculate peak metabolic heat generation (from OUR or sugar consumption) plus mechanical agitation power against target cooling capacity.

validation_tasks.title: Obtain missing vessel geometry and capability specifications
validation_tasks.description: Complete missing vessel profile fields from vendor engineering drawings or facility P&ID / datasheets.

validation_tasks.title: Verify DO sensitivity and minimum acceptable DO in bench-scale run
validation_tasks.description: Review bench-scale DO profiles and determine critical DO threshold below which specific productivity or viability degrades.

validation_tasks.title: Characterize mixing time in target vessel (or review existing facility mixing study)
validation_tasks.description: Obtain or perform a tracer mixing-time (t_95) study in the target vessel at planned agitation speed to assess substrate/pH gradient risk.

validation_tasks.title: Measure broth density and dynamic viscosity at process conditions
validation_tasks.description: Measure end-of-batch broth density and viscosity (and shear-rate dependence if non-Newtonian) to replace assumed medium properties.

validation_tasks.title: Domain-expert sign-off on pending-review formulas and power-number assumptions
validation_tasks.description: Have the bioprocess scientific lead and advisor review ungassed power number N_p and pending engineering correlations.
